findings.reason: without a tolerance against an independent reference the §3 node can complete without ever showing the integral is correct, which is the quantity the section exists to prove, and the followup's MAST-only fallback (solved-state) leaves the observed column unmeasured.
findings.text: §3's done-when proves only that no formula remains, that the receipt states its visible form, and that a figure is regenerated; it states no tolerance and no independent reference value, so "the constraint row carries no formula" passes by grep while the contour integral could carry any value and the delivered observed column is never shown to reproduce the archived EFIT beta_p + l_i/2

findings.reason: an instrument that never fires satisfies a zero-on-second assertion, so the node's whole reuse measure would rest on a counter nothing in the gate shows to be live.

findings.reason: a mechanism fixed in plan text is a guess the worker must reconcile against the solved-state API, and a wrong guess (e.g. wire to the large-aspect-ratio helper) costs a review round the endpoint-only wording would have avoided.
